title: DRE report
description: A report: SQL queries plus an output, in a YAML file under `reports/`.

name.description: The report's name. Default: the name of the folder the YAML file is in. Report names are unique across the project.

description.description: What this report answers, including its business definitions and units.

meta.description: Metadata for external tools. DRE checks its shape, not the meaning of its keys.

tags.description: Tags to select the report with, `-s tag:<tag>`.

queries.description: The `.sql` files whose results make the report's tabs, in the order they run, on one database session.

oneOf.description: The name of a `.sql` file under `reports/`, without extension.

output.description: One output, or a list of outputs formatted from the same run of the queries (file outputs are delivered before messages). A list replaces the inherited output; a map changes it.

profile.description: The connection (in `profiles.yml`) the queries run on, unless a query's own `profile:` or a source's says otherwise. Default: the folder's `+profile`, then `default_profile`. Can't be combined with `sets`. May use Jinja with `var()`, `env_var()`, `run.*` and `target.name`.

sets.description: The Sets the report can run as, by name (declared in `sets.yml`) or declared here.

default_set.description: The Set a plain `dre run` uses. Must be one of `sets`.

vars.description: Variables, read in SQL and YAML with `var('name')`. Values can be strings, numbers, booleans, lists or maps.

var_schema.description:
Optional declarations for variables: type, default, allowed values, description, required, and for strings a pattern and max_length.
Kept separate from `vars` so a map-valued variable remains a plain value.

timezone.description: The timezone `run.date` and `run.now` use, an IANA name such as `Australia/Sydney`. Default: UTC.

locale.description: The locale this report's number filters format for (`de-DE`). Default: the folder's `+locale`, then the project's `locale`, then `en`.

plugins.description: The plugin packages this project uses. DRE installs them on demand into `dre_deps/` and pins them in `dre.lock`. May be written in any project YAML file; `dependencies.yml` is the usual place.
plugins.x-doc-type: list of plugin packages: a name, `name: "<version>"`, or a map (see below)

items.description: One plugin package: just its name, a `name: "<version>"` pair, or a map with `name` and where to get it.

oneOf.description: A package name, e.g. `duckdb`. Any version.
A package name mapped to a version constraint, e.g. `duckdb: ">=1.0"`.

name.description: The package name: lowercase letters, digits and `_`.

version.description: A version constraint such as `1.2.0` or `>=1.0`. Not allowed with `local`.

github.description: Install from the releases of this GitHub repository, `owner/repo`.

local.description: Use the package folder at this path as it is.

registry.description: Install from this registry index (a URL or a path) instead of the default one.

oneOf.description: Package names mapped to version constraints.

sources.description: dbt-style source declarations (see the sources schema). May be written in any project YAML file.

queryEntry.description: A query with settings, instead of just its name.

query.description: The name of a `.sql` file under `reports/`, without folder or extension.

profile.description: The connection this query runs on, over the report's, Set's, folder's and project's. Must agree with the `profile` of any source it uses. May use Jinja with `var()`, `env_var()`, `run.*` and `target.name`.

tab.description: `false` runs the file only for what it does (temp tables, `SET`s) and discards any result, so it gets no tab.

tab_name.description: The tab (sheet) name. Default: the file's name. Not allowed with `tab: false`.

anchor.description: Where the data starts on the sheet (xlsx only). Default: `A1`.

header.description: Whether to write the column names as the first row (xlsx only). Default: the output's `header`.

columns.description: Per-column settings for this tab, by column name (xlsx only).

additionalProperties.description: Settings for one column of an xlsx tab.

format.description: The Excel number format of the column, e.g. `#,##0.00` or `dd/mm/yyyy`. See the xlsx column formats in the plugins reference.

formula.description: An Excel formula for each row of this column; `{name}` stands for that column's cell on the same row, e.g. `=ROUND({qty}*{unit_price},2)`. The SQL selects a placeholder column where the formula goes.

total.description: Puts a total under the column: one of `sum`, `count`, `average`, `min`, `max`, or a formula such as `=SUM({net:*})`.

style.description: How the column's data cells look: `bold`, `italic`, `underline`, `font` (`{name, size}`), `font_color`, `fill` (`"#RRGGBB"`), `align` (`left`, `center`, `right`), `border` (`none`, `thin`, `medium`). Over the tab's and output's `style`.

width.description: The column's width: `auto` (sized from its content, at most 60 characters) or a number of characters. Over the tab's and output's `autofit`.

on_empty.description: When this query returns no rows: `continue` keeps its empty tab or section, `skip` leaves its tab (or per-query file) out, `fail` fails the run. Wins over the output's `on_empty`. Default: the output decides once every query is empty.

secret_columns.description: Columns whose values are secrets (a PDF or zip password): values of 4 or more characters are masked as `*****` in the console, logs, `run_results.json`, `rows.jsonl`, `--output-json` and previews. Never masked in delivered files or messages.

autofit.description: Size this tab's columns from their content (xlsx only), over the output's `autofit`. Default: the output's, which is on.

style.description: How this tab looks (xlsx only), over the output's `style`: `font`, `header`, `totals`, `banded_rows`, `borders`, and cell keys (`bold`, `fill`, ...) for every data cell. See the xlsx plugin page.

header.description: Cell keys for the header row (default: bold).

totals.description: Cell keys for the totals row (default: bold, a thin top border).

banded_rows.description: The fill of every other data row, `"#RRGGBB"`, or `false`.

borders.description: A border around every cell of the table.

bold.description: Bold text in every data cell.

italic.description: Italic text in every data cell.

underline.description: Underlined text in every data cell.

border.description: A border around each data cell.

OnEmpty.description: `on_empty:` on an output or a query entry.

oneOf.description: Write the output (an empty section) and deliver it, with a warning.
Drop the query's tab or file; for an output: write and deliver nothing.

output.description: How a report's result is written and where it goes. Besides the keys below, each format takes its own options (for example `delimiter` for `delimited`, `columns` for `fixed_width`, `text` for `message`); they are documented with the formats.

name.description: Names the output so other outputs and Set overrides can refer to it (`outputs.<name>` in a message, `attach:`). Also the default file name (`<name>.<ext>`). Unique within the report.

format.description: The output format: `message` (built in: a short headline rendered from the results), or `csv`, `delimited`, `fixed_width`, `parquet` or `xlsx` (each a plugin). Default: `csv`, or the project's `default_output`.

queries.description: Which of the report's queries this output formats. Default: all of them. Each query runs once, whatever the number of outputs.

when.description: A Jinja expression over the results (`results.<query>.value < 0`); when it's false, the output is skipped and recorded as `skipped`.

destination.description: Where to deliver the file: one destination, or a list to deliver to several in one run. Default: the file stays in the target path.

for_each.description: One copy of the output per row of a driver query (`{query: members, key: member_id}`), each with its own slice of the results and the driver row as `each.*`; `false` turns an inherited one off. See docs/per-row-outputs.md.

file_name.description: A per-row output's file name, with Jinja (`"{{ each.member_id }}_statement.pdf"`). Default: the row's key and the format's extension, under a folder named after the output.

on_empty.description: When every query of the output returns no rows: `continue` (default) writes and delivers it empty, with a warning; `skip` writes and delivers nothing; `fail` fails the run. A query's own `on_empty` wins. See "When there's no data" in docs/building-reports.md.

extension.description: File extension for text formats (e.g. `aba`), instead of the format's own. `""` or `false` means none. Not for xlsx.

destination.description: Where a file is delivered: the name of a destination profile in `profiles.yml`, an optional `path`, and the options of that destination's plugin (e.g. `to`, `subject` and `body` for email). The built-in profile `local` copies the file to a local path.

profile.description: The destination profile in `profiles.yml` (under `destinations:`) to deliver with. `local` is built in. It uses its entry for the run (`--target`, `DRE_TARGET`, else the profile's own `target:`, else `dev`); a missing entry is an error, and an entry `{deliver: false}` delivers nowhere. May use Jinja with `var()`, `env_var()`, `run.*` and `target.name`.

path.description: Where to put the file: a path, or a URL such as `s3://bucket/key`, depending on the destination. Rendered with Jinja, so it can use `var()`, `run.*`, macros and `destination.*` (this destination's settings).

attach.description: On a message output's entry, for a destination that takes messages and files (`slack`, `email`): other outputs of the report whose files go with the message.

hold.description: Hold this delivery: the output is rendered and every other destination delivered, and this one waits for `dre release`. `dre run --hold` holds every destination.

rate.description: At most this many deliveries to this destination per second, minute or hour (`100/minute`, `5/second`, `20000/hour`), spaced evenly: `60/minute` sends one a second. For `dre run` and `dre release`; `--rate` overrides it.

burst.description: With `rate`: how many deliveries may go back to back while keeping the same average. Default: 1 (evenly spaced).

zip.description: Deliver one zip instead of loose files: the output's files plus every `attach:`ed output's, flat. `true` for no password, or `{password, encryption}`. The zip is named by `path` (which must end in `.zip`), else `<output>.zip`.

oneOf.description: `true`: zip the files, with no password.
Zip the files with a password.

password.description: The zip's password. Jinja: `env_var()`, `var()`, `each.*`. An empty password is an error.

encryption.description: `aes256` (default): strong; opens in 7-Zip, WinRAR, Keka. `zipcrypto`: weak, but opens in Windows Explorer and macOS Archive Utility.

template.description: The template an xlsx output fills (a branded workbook, instead of a new one), or an html or pdf output renders (a Jinja HTML + CSS file; see the document plugin).

file.description: The template file (`.xlsx` for xlsx, `.html` for html and pdf): a bare file name, found next to the report's YAML, then in each parent folder, then anywhere in the project (it must be unique); or a path with `/`, relative to the project root.

bindings.description: xlsx only: where each query's data goes in the template. Default: none, so the template is copied as it is.

items.description: One block of data in an xlsx template: a table of a query's result, or a single cell.

sheet.description: The template sheet to write into.

query.description: The query whose result goes here. Must be one of the Binding's queries.

result_index.description: Which result set of the query to use, counting from 1. Default: the last.

anchor.description: The top-left cell of a table block. A table block needs a `query`.

header.description: Whether to write the column names above the data in a table block.

columns.description: The columns of the query to write in a table block, in order. Default: all.

cell.description: Makes this a single-cell binding: the cell to write. Needs exactly one of `value`, or `query` with `column`.

value.description: A fixed value (rendered with Jinja) for a single-cell binding.

column.description: The column of the query's first row to write into a single-cell binding.

for_each.description: One copy of the output per row of a driver query (a per-row output): each copy gets only its row's slice of the results, and the driver row as `each.<column>` in every template of the output. `false` turns an inherited `for_each` off.

query.description: The driver: a query of the report, one row per copy of the output. It isn't a tab or section of the output itself.

key.description: The column (or list of columns) that identifies a row, in the driver and in every query of the output. Use an opaque id, never an email or a name: keys appear in file names and logs.

concurrency.description: How many rows render and deliver at once. Default: 4. `--row-concurrency` and `DRE_ROW_CONCURRENCY` override it.

on_row_error.description: `continue` (default): a failed row is recorded and the others carry on; the run ends failed. `fail`: render every row first, and deliver only if all rendered.

on_orphan_rows.description: Rows of a query whose key isn't in the driver: `warn` (default) or `fail`.

max_population_rows.description: The most rows across the output's queries before anything renders. Default: 5,000,000.

keep_results.description: Keep the run's query results in its run folder, for `--retry-failed`. Default: true.

mask_row_values.description: Mask destination values rendered from `each.*` (addresses, paths) in the console, logs and results. Default: the project's `mask_row_values`, true.

oneOf.description: Record a failed row and carry on; the run ends failed.
Render every row first; deliver only if all rendered.

setEntry.description: A Set declared in the report: a named variant of it.

name.description: The Set's name. A report can also name Sets declared in `sets.yml`.

profile.description: The connection this Set runs on. May use Jinja with `var()`, `env_var()`, `run.*` and `target.name`.

vars.description: Variables, read in SQL and YAML with `var('name')`. Values can be strings, numbers, booleans, lists or maps.

exclude.description: Queries to leave out of this Set, by name.

queries.description: Replaces the report's queries for this Set.

items.description: A query of this Set, by name, or with its own settings.

tab.description: Whether the query makes a tab.

on_empty.description: When this query returns no rows: keep its empty tab, leave it out, or fail the run.

secret_columns.description: Columns whose values are masked in DRE's logs, results and previews, added to the query's own.

tab_names.description: Renames tabs for this Set: query name to tab name.

output.description: Output settings for this Set: a map changes the inherited output (with several, the one its `name:` names); a list replaces them all.

locale.description: The locale for this Set's number filters (`fr-FR`), above the report's.

type.description: The value's type. Dates are real calendar dates in YYYY-MM-DD form.

description.description: What this input means, including its units or reporting period.

required.description: Whether execution requires a value. A default satisfies this requirement.

default.description: Used when no project, folder, report, Set, schedule or CLI value supplies this variable.

allowed.description: Optional exact values accepted for this variable; required for the enum type.

pattern.description:
For `string` variables: a regular expression the whole value must match, e.g.
`^[A-Z]{3}[0-9]{4}$` for a customer code. Anchors are implied.

max_length.description: For `string` variables: the most characters a value may have.

^x-.description: Anything, for YAML anchors (`&name`) reused with aliases (`*name`) and merges (`<<: *name`). DRE ignores these keys.
